Should I add a scan path description to the plan? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-ia-scan-path>

Should I replace the vague description with the DESIGN.md spec? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-save-pending-spec>

options.description: Replaces 'spinner or skeleton state' with the precise pattern: inline spinner + 'Saving…' label inside a disabled button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion-aware. Eliminates implementer ambiguity. Aligns Motion gap fix with DESIGN.md.

options.label: Leave as contrast problem statement
options.description: Keep 'contrast ratio is approximately 3:1 (below WCAG AA)'. The implementer consults DESIGN.md. Risk: they may pick a different red that still fails or lacks the icon requirement.

options.description: The plan already says 'two sizes would suffice.' Let the implementer choose which two. Risk: they may keep 14px (too small for WCAG body text) or pick non-DESIGN.md values.

options.label: Leave as 'restore on close'
options.description: Rely on the implementer's a11y knowledge to choose the standard restoration target. Risk: if they're not familiar with dialog focus management, focus may return to an unexpected place.

Should Retry be a button inside the live region, or an adjacent button outside it? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-retry-placement>

options.label: Retry inside InlineStatus live region (recommended)
options.description: Keep Retry inside the role=status region. WCAG allows interactive elements in live regions; screen readers announce 'Unsaved changes [Retry]' as one atomic update (aria-atomic=true). Simpler DOM, fewer components to coordinate.

options.label: Retry adjacent, outside the live region
options.description: Retry is a sibling button next to InlineStatus, not inside it. Cleaner separation of live content from interactive content. Slightly more complex DOM. Requires the implementer to handle show/hide coordination separately.

options.label: Stacked individually (full-width)
options.description: Each secondary button full-width on its own row. Large touch targets; very clear. Uses more vertical space. Three extra rows may make the action group feel heavy on mobile.

report.content:
# Design Review: Settings Page UI Redesign

**Plan source:** PLAN.md  
**Design system:** DESIGN.md (exists — all decisions calibrate against it)  
**Review type:** Text-only (7 design dimensions)  
**Date:** 2026-09-09

---

## Pre-Review System Audit

**DESIGN.md:** EXISTS. All 5 documented gaps have exact prescribed tokens in DESIGN.md.

**UI scope:** Settings form — Profile (Display name, Email) and Notifications (Weekly digest, Product tips). Existing shell, components, and behaviors in place.

**Existing components to reuse:** Button, Field, InlineStatus, ErrorSummary, ConfirmationDialog, form skeleton.

**Prior reviews:** None on file.

**Retrospective:** No prior design review cycles — treat this as a first pass with full rigor.

---

## Step 0: Design Scope Assessment

**Initial rating: 5/10**

The plan is a 5 because it specifies the structural shell and behavioral semantics well but treats its 5 implementation gaps as a problem list rather than a specification. Every gap names a deficiency; none prescribes the fix. DESIGN.md contains the exact tokens for all 5 — they just haven't been woven into the plan.

A **10** looks like: each gap section replaced with a concrete fix citing the DESIGN.md token; a scan-path description added to the IA section; interaction states expressed as a table; a journey storyboard covering the emotional arc.

**DESIGN.md status:** DESIGN.md found and read. All design decisions calibrate against it.

**Existing leverage:**
- `Button` — handles primary/ghost variant distinction
- `Field` — handles label-above-input layout
- `InlineStatus` — handles role=status, aria-live, "Saved at HH:mm" and "Unsaved changes"
- `ErrorSummary` — handles linked field errors
- `ConfirmationDialog` — handles Reset and Cancel dialogs
- Form skeleton — handles initial loading state

**Focus:** User pre-specified all 7 dimensions. Proceeding without narrowing.

---

## Pass 1: Information Architecture

**Initial rating: 7/10 → 9/10 after fix**

**Finding 1.1 (approved): Add scan path specification.**

The plan's DOM order diagram is correct but silent on visual attention hierarchy. The Visual Hierarchy gap names "nothing tells the user which is the primary action" — that's an IA failure, not just a styling problem. Save should be the dominant element the user's eye lands on after orienting.

**Fix added to plan:**
> Scan path: 1st — Account settings h1 + description (orientation, anchors context). 2nd — Save button (primary CTA; visual weight signals "this is what you do here"). 3rd — Profile fieldset (first editable area). 4th — Notifications fieldset. The InlineStatus sits between the action group and Profile, so it is in-path for status feedback without interrupting the task flow.

**What already exists:** DOM order and heading hierarchy are correctly specified. h1/h2 structure and the ASCII diagram in the plan are correct; no change needed there.

**Remaining gap (residual, 1pt):** The scan path fix anchors the IA, but the action group's visual weight is still not described in IA terms until the Visual Hierarchy gap receives its design-system fix (Pass 5).

---

## Pass 2: Interaction State Coverage

**Initial rating: 7/10 → 9/10 after fixes**

**Interaction state table (existing + fixes):**

| Feature | Loading | Empty | Error | Success | Pending/Partial |
|---------|---------|-------|-------|---------|-----------------|
| Page initial | Skeleton (existing) | Defaults for new account | Retry shown | — | — |
| Save | — | — | "Unsaved changes" + error message; edits preserved | "Saved at HH:mm" (aria-live) | Inline spinner beside "Saving…" inside disabled Save button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion-aware ← **Fix 2.1** |
| Field | — | — | Error beside field + ErrorSummary (linked via aria-describedby); first invalid field focused | — | — |
| Reset | — | — | — | Restores "Saved at HH:mm" for last save | — |
| Cancel (dirty) | — | — | — | Returns to previous page | — |
| Export | — | — | Inline error near Export button (reuse InlineStatus error pattern) ← **Fix 2.2** | Downloads JSON blob | — |
| Network (save) | — | — | "Unsaved changes" retained + Retry in status area | — | — |

**Finding 2.1 (approved): Replace vague "spinner or skeleton state" with DESIGN.md spec.**

Fix: "The Save pending state shows an inline spinner beside 'Saving…' text inside the disabled Save button. The button carries aria-busy=true. When prefers-reduced-motion is set, the spinner is hidden and 'Saving…' text alone conveys state."

**Finding 2.2 (approved): Add Export error state.**

Fix: "On Export failure, show an inline error message near the Export button using the existing InlineStatus error pattern. This preserves the user's position on the page and makes the failure recoverable."

**No finding:** Validation errors reference "exact existing DESIGN.md patterns" — DESIGN.md specifies ErrorSummary + field-level inline errors + aria-describedby linkage + focus-first-invalid-field. Sufficient for an implementer reading both documents.

---

## Pass 3: User Journey & Emotional Arc

**Rating: 7/10 → 8/10 after storyboard**

**Storyboard (derived from accepted requirements — no new decisions):**

| Step | User does | User feels | Plan specifies? |
|------|-----------|------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Arrives from account navigation | Purposeful; oriented ("I'm in the right place") | h1 "Account settings" + description ✓; persistent nav ✓ |
| 2 | Scans page (h1 → action group → Profile/Notifications) | Competent; fields look familiar | Scan path now specified (Fix 1.1) ✓ |
| 3 | Reads current field values | Reassured (server defaults present) or slightly scrutinizing | Server defaults for new account ✓; editable via existing Field component ✓ |
| 4 | Edits a field | Focused; confident | Labels above fields ✓; InlineStatus shifts to "Unsaved changes" immediately ✓ |
| 5 | Sees "Unsaved changes" status | Informed; no anxiety about losing work | InlineStatus (role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true) ✓ |
| 6 | Clicks Save | Intent, then a beat of uncertainty (2-5s is long enough to notice) | Spinner + "Saving…" + disabled button (Fix 2.1) ✓ after fix |
| 7 | Sees "Saved at HH:mm" | Confident, relieved; trust in the system | Persistent InlineStatus ✓; 24h local time ✓ |
| 8 | Considers leaving (dirty or clean) | Clean: just closes. Dirty: pauses | ConfirmationDialog for Cancel if dirty ✓; Escape cancels ✓ |

**5-second visceral:** Landing. The h1 + description + action group orientation is spec'd. The primary action (Save) will be visually dominant after Fix 5.1 (Pass 5). Currently the page reads as four equal buttons — the first impression is flat.

**5-minute behavioral:** The edit-save loop is well designed. InlineStatus dirty tracking prevents silent data loss. The save-pending state gap (now fixed) was the one place the behavioral flow broke.

**5-year reflective:** The "Saved at HH:mm" timestamp builds cumulative trust. Users who return will see their saved timestamp and know this system is reliable.

**Gap in plan (storyboard exposes):** Step 2's scan path was missing (fixed in Pass 1). Step 6's pending state was vague (fixed in Pass 2). No new decisions surfaced by the storyboard; all fixes are derived from accepted requirements and DESIGN.md.

---

## Pass 4: AI Slop Risk

**Rating: 9/10 — no hard rejections, no AI slop patterns**

**Classifier:** APP UI (settings form, task-focused, single-column, data-dense).

**Hard rejection check:** All 7 hard rejection criteria evaluated — none apply. This is a functional form, not a landing page or card-grid dashboard.

**Litmus checks:**

| Check | Verdict | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| Brand/product unmistakable? | NOT SPEC'D | App chrome is out of this plan's scope |
| One strong visual anchor? | YES (after fix) | Save button becomes #1d4ed8 filled primary via Pass 5 fix |
| Scannable by headlines only? | YES | h1 "Account settings" → h2 "Profile" → h2 "Notifications" ✓ |
| Each section one job? | YES | Profile ≠ Notifications; no mixing ✓ |
| Cards necessary? | N/A | No cards — fieldsets used correctly ✓ |
| Motion improves hierarchy? | YES | Spinner communicates pending state, not decoration ✓ |
| Premium without decorative shadows? | YES | Clean form, no ornamental elements described ✓ |

**AI slop blacklist:** None of the 10 patterns apply. The plan describes specific, intentional form UI: named components, exact tokens, behavioral specifications.

**One note:** DESIGN.md specifies font sizes (16px/20px) but not the typeface. The universal rule "no default font stacks" applies. Since this plan reuses existing components, the app's established typeface applies — this is a DESIGN.md gap, not this plan's gap. Flagged in "Not in scope" section.

---

## Pass 5: Design System Alignment

**Initial rating: 4/10**

DESIGN.md exists and has exact tokens for all 5 documented gaps. The plan's "Planned implementation gaps" section lists each gap as a problem statement only — no fix, no DESIGN.md token reference. A plan that identifies a gap without prescribing its fix is half-done.

**Gap 5 (Motion) is already resolved** via the Pass 2 fix (DESIGN.md spinner spec added). Gaps 1–4 approved below.

**Finding 5.1 (approved): Visual Hierarchy → DESIGN.md fix applied.**
Fix: "Save is the only filled primary action: `#1d4ed8` background with white text, using the existing Button primary variant. Reset, Cancel, and Export are neutral ghost buttons using the existing Button ghost variant. Destructive intent for Reset and Cancel is communicated through the existing ConfirmationDialog text, not the button color."

**Finding 5.2 (approved): Spacing → DESIGN.md scale applied.**
Fix: "Vertical rhythm uses an 8px base: between sections (Profile and Notifications fieldsets) = 32px; between field groups within a section = 24px; between label and its input = 8px. Remove the inconsistent 16px gap currently present."

**Finding 5.3 (approved): Color → DESIGN.md tokens applied.**
Fix: "Error state uses `error.text = #991b1b` on `error.surface = #fef2f2`, always accompanied by an error icon and explicit text label. Status is never communicated through color alone. This pair meets WCAG AA contrast."

**Finding 5.4 (approved): Typography → two-role system applied.**
Fix: "Typography uses exactly two roles: 16px for body text, form labels, and helper text; 20px for section headings (Profile, Notifications h2). Remove 14px and 18px entirely. No third size."

**Pass 5 final rating: 4/10 → 9/10 after all 4 fixes.**

---

## Pass 6: Responsive & Accessibility

**Rating: 9/10 → 10/10 after fix**

**What the plan specifies well (no changes):**
- 640px breakpoint for action group layout ✓
- Mobile: full-width Save first, three secondary below, DOM/tab order preserved ✓
- 320px no horizontal scroll ✓
- 44px minimum touch targets ✓
- 2px solid `#1d4ed8` focus ring, offset 2px, contrast >3:1 on all controls and dialog actions ✓
- Semantic fieldsets, labels, main landmark, h1/h2 heading order, no heading skips ✓
- aria-describedby linking errors to fields ✓
- InlineStatus: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true ✓
- Dialogs trap focus; Escape cancels ✓
- Reduced motion respected ✓
- aria-busy=true on Save button during pending (covered by Pass 2 fix) ✓

**Finding 6.1 (approved): Dialog focus restoration target clarified.**
Fix: "Dialogs restore focus to the button that triggered them (Reset returns focus to the Reset button; Cancel returns focus to the Cancel button) when closed by any means (Escape, 'Keep editing', 'Discard changes', 'Discard and leave')."

---

## Pass 7: Unresolved Design Decisions

**Initial: 2 unresolved → 0 after decisions**

| Decision needed | If deferred, what happens |
|-----------------|--------------------------|
| Retry placement: inside vs. adjacent to InlineStatus | Implementer makes an ad-hoc call; may pick wrong a11y pattern |
| Mobile secondary layout: row vs. stacked | Implementer guesses; may use full-width stack that feels heavy |

**Decision 7.1 (resolved): Retry inside InlineStatus.**
Fix: "The Retry control for network errors appears as a button inside the InlineStatus live region. With aria-atomic=true, the entire region ('Unsaved changes [Retry]') is announced as one unit when updated."

**Decision 7.2 (resolved): Mobile secondary layout = single row.**
Fix: "Below 640px, Reset, Cancel, and Export appear in a single row below the full-width Save button. Each secondary button uses compact padding to fit three buttons within the 320px minimum viewport while meeting the 44px touch-target height requirement."

---

## Required Outputs

### What already exists

| Component | Purpose in this plan |
|-----------|---------------------|
| `Button` (primary variant) | Save action — `#1d4ed8` filled with white text |
| `Button` (ghost variant) | Reset, Cancel, Export |
| `Field` | Display name, Email, Weekly digest, Product tips |
| `InlineStatus` | "Saved at HH:mm", "Unsaved changes", network error + Retry |
| `ErrorSummary` | Linked validation error summary |
| `ConfirmationDialog` | Reset ("Discard unsaved changes?") and Cancel ("Discard and leave?") |
| Form skeleton | Initial loading state |
| Focus-visible ring | 2px solid `#1d4ed8`, offset 2px — applied to all controls and dialog actions |

### NOT in scope

| Item | Rationale |
|------|-----------|
| Typeface selection for design system | DESIGN.md specifies font sizes but not typeface. The existing app typeface applies. Fixing the missing typeface spec is app-wide DESIGN.md debt — tracked below in TODOS. |
| Navigation / page chrome design | Out of scope; persistent app nav is an existing shell component. |
| New component families | Plan explicitly reuses existing components; no new ones. |
| Visual exploration of layout alternatives | Single-column structure is an approved constraint. |

### TODOS.md updates

**Proposed TODO — DESIGN.md typeface gap:**

- **What:** Add a typeface specification to DESIGN.md (e.g., "Geist Mono" or whatever the app uses).
- **Why:** The universal design rule "no default font stacks" applies. DESIGN.md currently specifies sizes (16px/20px) but not the typeface. Without this, the form may render in system-ui or whatever the browser defaults to.
- **Pros:** Closes the last typography ambiguity. Prevents future components from drifting to different stacks.
- **Cons:** Requires an app-wide decision that's larger than this PR.
- **Context:** This is DESIGN.md debt, not a gap in the settings plan itself. All settings-page specs are complete.
- **Depends on:** None — purely additive to DESIGN.md.

---

## Implementation Tasks

Synthesized from this review's findings. Each derives from a specific finding above.

- [ ] **T1 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Button — Apply primary vs. ghost variant to action group
  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 / Finding 5.1 — Save has same visual treatment as Reset/Cancel/Export
  - Files: action group component or settings page template
  - Verify: Save renders `#1d4ed8` filled; Reset/Cancel/Export render ghost. Visually confirm in browser.

- [ ] **T2 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Spacing — Normalize section/field-group/label spacing to 8px scale
  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 / Finding 5.2 — 24px/32px/16px used inconsistently
  - Files: settings page stylesheet or CSS-in-JS tokens
  - Verify: sections 32px, field groups 24px, label-to-input 8px — no other values present.

- [ ] **T3 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Color — Replace error color pair with `#991b1b` / `#fef2f2`
  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 / Finding 5.3 — current error contrast ≈ 3:1 (below WCAG AA)
  - Files: error component stylesheet / design token file
  - Verify: Automated contrast check ≥ 4.5:1 on error text. Error also shows icon + text label.

- [ ] **T4 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Typography — Remove 14px and 18px; use 16px (body) / 20px (headings) only
  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 / Finding 5.4 — three font sizes where two suffice
  - Files: settings page stylesheet or typography token file
  - Verify: No `font-size` value other than 16px or 20px in settings page scope.

- [ ] **T5 (P1, human: ~45min / CC: ~10min)** — InlineStatus / Save — Implement DESIGN.md save-pending pattern
  - Surfaced by: Pass 2 / Finding 2.1 — "spinner or skeleton state" too vague
  - Files: Save button component, InlineStatus component
  - Verify: During save, button shows inline spinner + "Saving…", is disabled, carries aria-busy=true. With prefers-reduced-motion set, spinner hidden, "Saving…" text alone shown.

- [ ] **T6 (P2, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Export — Add error state to Export action
  - Surfaced by: Pass 2 / Finding 2.2 — no Export failure path specified
  - Files: Export handler, InlineStatus usage near Export
  - Verify: Simulating a blob download failure shows an inline error message near Export; user can retry.

- [ ] **T7 (P2, human: ~20min / CC: ~5min)** — Dialog — Clarify focus restoration to triggering element
  - Surfaced by: Pass 6 / Finding 6.1 — "restore focus on close" ambiguous
  - Files: ConfirmationDialog component
  - Verify: After Reset dialog closes (any action), focus is on Reset button. After Cancel dialog closes, focus is on Cancel button.

- [ ] **T8 (P2, human: ~20min / CC: ~5min)** — Responsive — Clarify mobile secondary action row layout
  - Surfaced by: Pass 7 / Decision 7.2 — three secondaries below Save not specified as row vs. stacked
  - Files: settings page responsive styles
  - Verify: At 320px, Reset/Cancel/Export appear in one row below full-width Save, each ≥ 44px tall.

- [ ] **T9 (P2, human: ~15min / CC: ~3min)** — IA — Add scan path to plan/implementation notes
  - Surfaced by: Pass 1 / Finding 1.1 — no visual attention hierarchy specified
  - Files: plan only (already added) — implementer references for visual QA
  - Verify: After implementation, visual scan matches: h1 → Save (dominant) → Profile → Notifications.

_No new tasks from Pass 4 (AI Slop — no findings)._

---

## Completion Summary

```
+====================================================================+

```

options.label: Annotate with tokens (Recommended)
options.description: Add to gap: 'Fix: error.text #991b1b on error.surface #fef2f2 with icon; target ≥4.5:1 contrast (WCAG AA normal text).' Unambiguous for implementer.

options.label: Leave as-is
options.description: Gap already says 'below WCAG AA'. Implementer picks their own compliant colors. Risk: they may choose colors that pass AA but don't match the design system.

questions.question: Pass 5 / Gap 5d — Typography: Plan says 14px, 16px, 18px are in use. DESIGN.md says 16px (body/labels/helper) and 20px (section headings). This means 14px and 18px are both wrong. Which elements are currently using 14px vs. 18px? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-gap5d-typography>

options.label: Annotate + note requires code audit (Recommended)
options.description: Add to gap: 'Fix: consolidate to 16px (labels, helper text, body) and 20px (section headings per DESIGN.md). Note: plan says 18px in use where DESIGN.md requires 20px — this means headings are undersized. 14px likely on helper/caption text that should be 16px. Audit needed.' Implementer knows what to look for.

options.label: Flag as unresolved pending code audit
options.description: Don't annotate the fix tokens until the code is audited. Keeps the gap open until Pass 7 resolution. Safer but slower.

questions.question: Pass 5 / Gap 5e — Motion: Save has no loading indicator (2-5s freeze). Should I annotate the gap with the DESIGN.md pending pattern? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-gap5e-motion>

options.label: Annotate with full pattern (Recommended)
options.description: Add to gap: 'Fix: inline spinner beside \'Saving…\' text inside the disabled Save button; aria-busy=true on button; CSS animation; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → show text only, no animation.' DESIGN.md pattern, completely specified.

options.label: Leave as-is
options.description: Gap identifies the problem. Implementer can choose any loading pattern. Risk: spinner in wrong location, missing aria-busy, or missing reduced-motion support.

questions.question: Design review complete (5/10 → 9/10, 6 decisions made). 8 implementation tasks ready. Eng Review is the required shipping gate. What next? <gstack-qid:plan-design-review-next-steps>

options.label: Run /plan-eng-review (Recommended)
options.description: Validate architectural implications of the 8 tasks (aria-busy, animation timing, atomic save, InlineStatus state machine). Required gate before shipping.

options.label: Skip — handle next steps manually
options.description: Plan is design-complete. You'll decide when and whether to run eng review separately.
